comments.body: I would like to talk about this https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/774. It has changes required for the sparse blobpool, which is CFIed for glamsterdam.
On Monday's ACDT, we didn't get to SFI eth/70 and eth/71, both included in the next devnet. Would be great to get to that.

We should try to discuss the following prs: 

Gas limit:
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/796
https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5235
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3756 vs https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11644
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11607

Increase the withdrawability delay for builder deposits 
https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5223

Engine ssz
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/764 vs https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793
Myself and @jsign would like to PFI EIP-8025 for H* - https://github.com/frisitano/EIPs/blob/feat/eip8025/EIPS/eip-8025.md if possible please

I'd like to talk about https://github.com/ethp2p/ethp2p/pull/5 . It's a redesign of current committee attestations. It reduces the used bandwidth allowing us to increase the committee sizes. 

The spec is at: ~https://github.com/ethp2p/ethp2p/blob/7a9a220838a32295c4631edc94483adf20bb7722/specs/draft-attestation-propagation.md~

https://github.com/ethp2p/ethp2p/blob/7a9a220838a32295c4631edc94483adf20bb7722/specs/draft-committee-attestation.md

The design isn't completely final and we can probably make it backwards compatible but if we can't I'd like to propose it for H*
If time allows, I would like to PFI [EIP-7684](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7684) and [EIP-8148](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148) for Hegota.
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
